verdict.rationale: Source availability under an open license is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack never says the LangSmith platform's source is published or names any license. The GitHub items cover only the client SDK, with no license mentioned. Self-hosting docs describe running the platform in your own infrastructure but do not say the code is open. The llms.txt reference to "open source packages" covers LangChain's separate libraries, not LangSmith itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
